title: Binance Accelerator Program - Events
description: About the Team: The Global Events team is responsible for delivering Binance's key events and experiences across the world. From large-scale flagship conferences and community events to VIP experiences, KOL programmes and smaller regional activations, we create memorable experiences that bring the Binance brand to life. Working closely with teams across Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Product and regional markets, the Global Events team manages events across multiple countries and time zones. As part of the team, you'll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience working on both large-scale international events and smaller, high-impact initiatives. About the role: We are looking for a proactive and organised Global Events Intern to support the team across the full event lifecycle, from research and planning to onsite execution and post-event reporting. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with experienced event managers and have the opportunity to contribute to real global events. You'll support a wide range of activities including event coordination, guest and ticket management, venue research, social media engagement, swag and onsite operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. You should be someone who takes ownership, is not afraid to get involved in the details and can work independently while collaborating effectively with a global team.
